text: Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id, drug_indication.efo_term AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%Non-Small Cell Lung%' OR drug_indication.efo_term LIKE '%non-small cell lung%'. Sort: None. Limit: None.
